verdict.rationale: Buzz is a team chat product, so posting into a channel through an incoming webhook is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no incoming webhook URL. Messages are posted through the Buzz CLI, the ACP harness, or Nostr clients using signed NIP-42/NIP-98 events, which are adjacent mechanisms rather than a simple webhook URL.

support.subject: As a developer, I can post a message into a channel with a simple incoming webhook URL
